one_liner: We turn thyroidectomy into a controlled human perturbation experiment to read whether PTC CTC-EMT states collapse, persist, or genetically match residual-risk biology.
The novelty is not CTC counting; it is serial CTC-EMT state transition plus matched tumor-normal/cfDNA genetic anchoring around surgery.
Public omics do not prove CTC biology; they prove mutation alone is too weak and provide the marker/genetic map needed for the prospective test.
AI models help interpret longitudinal clone-state transitions, but the category identity is a biological perturbation question.
The project is narrow, falsifiable, stage-gated, and capable of producing interpretable biology even when the strongest scenario fails.
